{'0': "The next year's iPhone Pro models are expected to adopt a brand-new all-glass design, coinciding with the 20th anniversary of the iPhone. Today, the latest leaks detailed Apple's progress on this innovative model."}

{'1': "Below is the latest news on Apple's unique iPhone 20 Pro design"}

{'2': "With Apple's first foldable phone—the innovative iPhone Ultra—just weeks away from launch, next year will see another uniquely designed new iPhone make its debut."}

{'3': "Reports indicate Apple is preparing a special all-glass design for next year's iPhone Pro models. The new device is said to feature a larger screen with a quad-curved display extending to the edges of the body, creating a nearly bezel-less visual effect."}

{'4': 'Weibo tipster "定焦數碼" posted a new update today on Apple\'s progress in achieving this distinctive look.'}

{'5': 'He stated that Apple adopted the same glass assembly process as the iPhone Air, but modified it with rounder materials.'}

{'6': 'The post also pointed out improvements in two areas:'}

  • {'7': 'Thermal performance'}
  • {'8': 'Body slimness'}

{'9': "It is still too early to confirm Apple's target specifications regarding thickness and design materials. However, from various signs, this new model will draw on elements from the iPhone Air and Ultra, but unlike those two devices, slimness will not be its primary consideration."}

{'10': 'Based on this latest information, the new phone is expected to blend the design innovations of the iPhone Air and Ultra, while also delivering the performance and battery life that Pro users expect.'}

{'11': 'Pro users do not want slimness to be the primary trade-off. But if Apple can deliver a nearly identical user experience on a slightly slimmer device, combined with a unique all-glass aesthetic, the appeal would be considerable.'}

{'12': "How interested are you in next year's rumored iPhone Pro 20 model? Let us know in the comments."}
